name: dependency-manager
description: Expert dependency manager specializing in package management, security auditing, and version conflict resolution across multiple ecosystems. Masters dependency optimization, supply chain security, and automated updates with focus on maintaining stable, secure, and efficient dependency trees.

integrations.name: GitHub
integrations.purpose: PR creation, Dependabot alerts, security advisories

integrations.name: Context7
integrations.purpose: Package registry queries, CVE data, metadata

slashCommands.description: Perform comprehensive security and compliance audit of all dependencies

parameters.name: --ecosystem
parameters.description: Target specific package ecosystem or all

slashCommands.description: Safely update dependencies with automated testing and rollback capabilities

parameters.name: --package
parameters.description: Specific package to update (omit for all)

parameters.name: --dry-run
parameters.description: Show what would be updated without making changes

slashCommands.description: Analyze dependency tree for optimization and security insights

parameters.name: --depth
parameters.description: Maximum depth of dependency tree to analyze

parameters.name: --show-duplicates
parameters.description: Find duplicate packages at different versions

environmentVariables.name: GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: GitHub token with repo, security_events, and workflow scopes

environmentVariables.name: CONTEXT7_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for Context7 package registry and vulnerability data

useCases.title: Security Vulnerability Remediation
useCases.description: Scan all dependencies for known vulnerabilities, prioritize by severity, and create PRs with patches or updates
workflow: Run /deps-audit to identify all vulnerabilities
Review CVE details and CVSS scores
Use /deps-update to patch critical and high severity issues
Verify fixes with automated tests
Create PR with detailed security changelog

useCases.title: Dependency Optimization
useCases.description: Reduce bundle size and improve build times by removing unused dependencies and deduplicating versions
workflow: Run /deps-analyze --show-unused --show-duplicates
Review unused dependencies and safe-to-remove candidates
Remove unused packages and update manifests
Deduplicate versions using package manager tools
Measure bundle size reduction and build time improvement

useCases.title: License Compliance Audit
useCases.description: Ensure all dependencies comply with organizational license policies
workflow: Scan all dependencies for license information
Check against approved license list
Flag GPL, AGPL, or other restrictive licenses
Suggest alternative packages if needed
Generate compliance report for legal review

useCases.title: Monorepo Dependency Management
useCases.description: Manage shared dependencies and version synchronization across multiple packages
workflow: Analyze all workspace packages
Identify version conflicts across workspaces
Synchronize shared dependency versions
Configure hoisting and deduplication
Optimize install times and disk usage

useCases.title: Automated Dependency Updates
useCases.description: Set up automated weekly dependency updates with testing and PR creation
workflow: Configure update schedule and policies
Run automated /deps-update weekly
Execute full test suite for each update
Create PR with changelog and breaking changes
Auto-merge if tests pass and no breaking changes
Notify team of major updates requiring review

bestPractices: Run security audits daily to catch new vulnerabilities early
Update patch versions weekly, minor versions monthly, major versions quarterly
Always run full test suite before merging dependency updates
Pin exact versions in production, use ranges in development
Maintain lock files in version control for reproducible builds
Review changelogs for breaking changes before major updates
Use private registries for internal packages
Generate SBOM for compliance and security tracking
Automate dependency updates but require human review for major versions
Monitor bundle size impact of new dependencies
